description: This file contains utility functions to detect browser environment, show confirmation dialogs, and execute functions safely in a browser context, with SSR (Server-Side Rendering) compatibility.

methods.name: export function isBrowser(): boolean { isBrowser
methods.description: Checks if the code is running in a browser environment by verifying the presence of 'window' and 'document' objects.

methods.name: export function showConfirm(message: string): boolean { showConfirm
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog if in a browser environment, otherwise defaults to false (simulating no user confirmation) for SSR compatibility.

methods.name: export function browserOnly<T>(fn: () => T, fallback?: T): T | undefined { browserOnly
methods.description: Executes a provided function only in a browser environment; otherwise returns a fallback value if provided.
